title.en: Air transport, shipping, ports and communications

text.en:
Ravi flew for the first time and saw ships at the Chennai port.
"Air and sea link us to the world," said his uncle.

Air transport is fast and used for long distances and valuable or urgent goods. India has many airports and airlines.
Shipping carries most of India's trade by sea through major ports like Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata, because ships can carry heavy goods cheaply.
Communications infrastructure includes post, telephone, mobile networks and the internet, which help us share information. We must take care of public infrastructure together.

problem.en: Why is shipping used for heavy goods?

text.en: It is cheap for long distances.
So most trade goes by sea.

prompt.en: A friend says most of India's trade goes by air. How will you reply?

points.en: Air is fast, ships carry heavy loads.
